entries.say.1.neutral: Damn it, {slot.killer.name}. You took {target.name} from their family. This will not go unanswered.
entries.say.2.neutral: I saw {target.name} fall. {slot.killer.name} will answer for this, I swear it.
entries.say.3.neutral: What {slot.killer.name} did to {target.name} will never be forgiven.
entries.say.4.neutral: Hell, {target.name}. {slot.killer.name} is going to pay for this.
entries.say.5.neutral: I will not let {target.name}'s death go unanswered. {slot.killer.name} started this.
entries.say.6.neutral: No. Not {target.name}. {slot.killer.name} just made this personal.
entries.say.8.neutral: Rest now, {target.name}. I hope {slot.killer.name} runs, because I am coming.
